say: Aero needed a page to live on.
At first, the page was just the game on a dark background.
Then we added a scroll of square clips, each one rendered from the game in a square shape.
The sky behind them is a generated image, and its top edge is uneven, with clouds in the corners.
A flat blue band above it would leave a visible seam.
So the image fades in through a gradient mask, over a blue sampled from its own top edge.
The clips only play while they are on screen, and the game waits at the bottom, sitting on the clouds.
The whole site is a single HTML file, served by a Cloudflare Worker.
